sections.title: 🎯 What You'll Learn
sections.content:
Nested loops might sound fancy, but they're just loops inside loops! Think of them like a clock: the hour hand (outer loop) moves slowly, while the minute hand (inner loop) zooms around.

• How to write loops inside other loops
• Why nested loops are powerful (and when to use them)
• Common patterns and real-world uses

sections.title: 💡 Concept Explanation
sections.content:
Imagine you're at a concert with rows of seats. The outer loop counts each row, and the inner loop counts each seat in that row. That's a nested loop!

Nested loops let you repeat actions in a grid-like pattern. The outer loop runs once, and the inner loop runs completely for each outer loop iteration.

• Outer loop: Controls the big picture (like rows)
• Inner loop: Handles the details (like seats in a row)
• Each inner loop must finish before the outer loop moves forward

sections.title: 📊 Visual Simulation
sections.content: Step-by-step visualization of how Nested Loops works:

steps.title: Outer Loop Starts
steps.description: The outer loop begins with i = 1. The inner loop hasn't started yet.

steps.title: Inner Loop Runs
steps.description: For i = 1, the inner loop runs completely (j = 1 to 3). Then i increments to 2.

steps.title: Final Output
steps.description: The pattern repeats for i = 2 and i = 3. Result: (1,1) (1,2) (1,3) (2,1) ... (3,3)

sections.title: ⚡ Key Points
points: ✓ Outer loop runs once → inner loop runs completely
✓ Inner loop is faster (like minute vs. hour hand)
✓ Total iterations = outer × inner loop iterations
✓ Great for grids, tables, and multi-dimensional data
✓ Watch out for infinite loops (always check conditions!)

sections.title: 🔥 Tips & Mistakes
dos: Keep inner loops simple and fast
donts: Don’t nest too deep (3+ levels gets messy)
Avoid complex logic in inner loops
Don’t forget to reset inner loop variables
sections.protip: Use `break` in inner loops to exit early if needed (e.g., searching a grid).

sections.title: 🌍 Real World Use
sections.content: Where is Nested Loops used in real apps?

examples.how: Outer loop: rows, Inner loop: columns → fills cells with formulas.
Outer loop: game frames, Inner loop: updates all objects per frame.
Outer loop: rows of pixels, Inner loop: columns → edits each pixel.

problem.description:
Print a right-angled triangle of stars (*) with 5 rows. Example:
*
**
***
****
*****
hints: The inner loop runs `i` times for each row.
problem.explanation: Outer loop (i) controls rows. Inner loop (j) prints stars equal to the current row number (i).

sections.title: 📝 Summary
points: 📌 Nested loops = loops inside loops (like a clock’s hands)
📌 Outer loop: slow, Inner loop: fast and repetitive
📌 Practice with grids, patterns, and tables
